trust_decision.summary: Which Wings operation a Panel-issued JWT may authorise is decided at mint time: each call site declares an intent scope via setScopes() and NodeJWTService::handle() is the single place that signs the token and must refuse to sign without one. At the pinned commit handle() writes no scope claim at all, so every token minted for any route has the same shape and any node-signed token is accepted by any Wings endpoint, letting a token obtained for the websocket (needing only websocket.connect) be replayed against Wings' file-upload endpoint and bypassing the panel's file.create check.

landing_point.why: The report says a subuser can upload files without file.create, so the first place an engineer looks is the handler that mints the upload URL and its permission check.

fix_sites.entry_point: NodeJWTService::handle() public API, called by all five HTTP entry points below
Pterodactyl\Enum\JwtScope, new value type consumed by setScopes() at every mint site

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The backup-download and admin-transfer tokens are minted for a different feature and a different actor than the reported subuser upload, and the shared handle() method can be argued to need no fail-closed guard because all of its callers were already updated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A subuser holding only websocket.connect (no file.create) must still get a working websocket token, and during a server transfer that token is minted for transfer->newNode and must keep carrying the permissions claim; a fix that re-checks file.create on the websocket route, binds the token to $server->node, or drops the permissions claim breaks console access and transfer-log viewing.

O6_input_shapes: zero scopes: handle() must raise instead of signing an unscoped token
several scopes in one token: variadic setScopes joined into a single space-delimited 'scope' claim
user-bound token (setUser, user_uuid claim) vs subject-only token with no user (admin transfer)
legacy third argument $algo (implicit md5, explicit 'sha256' from the admin controller) normalised to sha256 with the parameter removed

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a backup restore/upload link that mints its own Wings token
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: restore already drives Wings (app/Http/Controllers/Api/Client/Servers/BackupController.php:198); a maintainer adding a Wings-side restore or upload URL would mint a second token here rather than reuse DownloadLinkService.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CLI command that mints a scoped one-time token for Wings instead of using the node key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the command already speaks to Wings; a maintainer adding console/websocket access from the CLI would reuse NodeJWTService and be the sixth, easily missed call site.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an application-API server build/transfer action that mints a Wings token
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the admin and application APIs both act on servers; a maintainer exposing transfer or reinstall through the application API would mint the token in that package, far from the client API where the report points.

O9_family: improper authorisation through unscoped security-token assignment (CWE-1259 / CWE-1270): a bearer token minted for one protected sink is accepted by every other sink using the node key

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^8.2 || ^8.3, Composer v2, Laravel 11, lcobucci/jwt ^5.6, webmozart/assert
services: MySQL or MariaDB (integration tests need a database whose name contains 'test')
O10_build.project_tests: PHPUnit 10.5; tests/Integration/Api/Client/Server/WebsocketControllerTest.php asserts the JWT claims at the pinned commit (user_id at line 89, server_uuid, permissions) but no scope; there is no test for the upload/download/transfer token sites and no NodeJWTService unit test (tests/Integration/Services/Backups only has DeleteBackupServiceTest.php).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Re-check file.create in the upload handler (or refuse upload tokens in WebsocketController) and stop, treating it as a missing per-route permission check rather than a missing scope claim on every token.

out_of_scope_notes: The scope claim is consumed by Wings (pterodactyl/wings, a separate Go repository, GO-2026-6120); that enforcement code is not in this tree and was not examined.
